events.title: Employee Dies From Injuries in Fall from Scaffold
events.description: 1 worker death. Employer: Asap Environmental Inc. Crystal Lake, IL. At approximately 5:00 p.m. on January 11, 2015, an employee was working at a commercial property where he was cleaning metal web trusses that would be painted at a later date. The employee was climbing the scaffold to return to the work area when he fell approximately six feet, striking his head on the concrete floor. Emergency services were called to the scene. The injured employee was hospitalized and died the following day.
